name: Fresno County, CA
findings: Fresno County has 2,362 nonprofit organizations. 907 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 695 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fresno County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
